# Handling User Input Safely

Validate all user input against strict whitelists before usage:

```bash
validate_username() {
    local u="$1"
    [[ "$u" =~ ^[a-z_][a-z0-9_-]{0,31}$ ]] || {
        echo "Error: Invalid username format" >&2
        return 1
    }
}
```
